mentions.name: dark software factory
mentions.description: A dark software factory: an autonomous system that takes stray thoughts and automatically plans and builds software. The main iteration runs full time waiting for the next idea; a second iteration targeted an open weights model and worked in limited cases; the third, in-progress iteration is more autonomous, taking only a goal and a strategy and deciding its own projects.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been building a dark software factory. A system that takes stray thoughts and automatically plans and builds.
